name: Vehicular Networking and V2X Communications
description: Introduction to vehicular communications and V2X requirements (latency, reliability, scalability, awareness range); ITS spectrum and multichannel operation; ETSI ITS architecture and protocol stack (Access, Networking/Transport, Facilities, Applications); wireless propagation for mobility (pathloss, shadowing, multipath, Doppler) and SINR-based performance limits; V2X radio technologies (IEEE 802.11p/ITS-G5, LTE-V2X, and 5G NR-V2X); MAC/resource allocation (CSMA/CA, sensing-based SPS, sidelink scheduling, RAN Slicing); ETSI Decentralized Congestion Control (DCC); GeoNetworking/BTP; Facilities-layer services and V2X messages (CAM, DENM, CPM, MCM) for cooperative awareness, cooperative perception, and maneuver coordination applications.
